reviews.review_title: Review at Ha Thanh Mansion Vietnamse Restaurant
reviews.review_text:
Rosie H
Ipswich, United Kingdom148 contributions
0
All very tasty
Sep 2026 • Couples
Delicious. Don’t be put off by some of the more unusual dishes on offer, we didn’t fancy the hedgehog or pork innards, there is far more to choose from and not be disappointed. We tried fresh prawn spring rolls, wrapped in lettuce rather than than the usual style but with added ginger soaked rice which was very tasty. Main course of the signature dish of pork fried in lemon grass was great as was the morning glory with loads of garlic. Together with a dish of hit chilli squid, one cocktail and three beer at about £45 it was an absolute bargain.

Seemed quite busy, might be a good idea to book ahead
